paraphrase: Formal facts about the #487 bridge. Over all profiles, inhabitedness, restricted well-foundedness, the closing premise and excluded middle give one witness that is an actual root and necessary. One model satisfies the seven clauses of the first-being derivation with a maximum, a simple priority between distinct beings and a cause of necessity between distinct beings. For each of the seven clauses a model satisfies the other six while the first-being premise fails. One model has inhabitedness, restricted well-foundedness, the closing premise and two distinct necessary actual roots, while grades-have-a-maximum, something-is-moved and the first-being premise fail. Over all profiles, the first-being premise follows from asymmetry of the selected relation on actual concreta, excluded middle, the genus principle, the simple-priority bridge and two bridges covering every actual concretum (each has being; a cause of its being other than itself is an actual concrete ground), and one model satisfies those non-logical premises with a contingent maximum and no necessary concretum. One model has a necessary actual root at one world with an actual concrete ground at an accessible world. One model with a past lacking a first moment has a law that whatever begins has a ground, while the closing premise fails. No model is claimed metaphysically possible.
